note.subject: history_culture
note.why_in_news: Commemoration of Mahatma Gandhi's 157th birth anniversary highlighting his leadership in the Non-Cooperation and Dandi March movements.
note.fact_box: Mahatma Gandhi was born on October 2, 1869, in Porbandar and was assassinated on January 30, 1948, in Delhi. He led pivotal movements including the Non-Cooperation Movement, Dandi March (Salt Satyagraha), and the Quit India Movement.

prelims_pointers.text: Mahatma Gandhi was a lawyer by profession before leading the freedom movement.
Gandhi was born in Porbandar, Gujarat.
The Dandi March is also known as the Salt Satyagraha.

mcq.question: With reference to Mahatma Gandhi and the Indian freedom struggle, consider the following statements:
statements: Mahatma Gandhi was assassinated on 30 January 1947.
The Dandi March is also known as the Salt Satyagraha.
Mahatma Gandhi was born in Delhi in 1869.
mcq.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mcq.explanation: Statement 2 is correct. Statement 1 is incorrect: He was assassinated on 30 January 1948. Statement 3 is incorrect: He was born in Porbandar.

note.subject: environment
note.why_in_news: The Idukki district administration and Forest Department are clearing natural passages in the Devikulam forest range to mitigate escalating human-wildlife conflicts.
note.fact_box: The initiative targets the Chinnakkanal area in the Devikulam forest range of Idukki district. Data reveals 81 deaths and 486 injuries over a decade, with 10 deaths recorded in the 2023-24 period.

prelims_pointers.text: Chinnakkanal and Devikulam forest range are located in the Idukki district of Kerala.
Human-wildlife conflict in the region resulted in 81 deaths and 486 injuries over a 10-year period.
The 2023-24 period recorded 10 deaths due to human-wildlife conflict in the region.

note.mains_question: Discuss the ecological and socio-economic challenges of human-wildlife conflict in fragmented habitats and evaluate the efficacy of translocation as a mitigation strategy.

note.subject: social_justice
note.why_in_news: Kerala Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan announced a separate housing scheme for SC/ST communities to bypass delays in the Life Mission project.
note.fact_box: The Kerala government announced an additional ₹500 crore for SC/ST welfare schemes in the 2026 budget. The state also plans to establish the world's first tribal university in Wayanad to preserve indigenous culture.

prelims_pointers.text: Life Mission: A flagship housing scheme by the Government of Kerala to provide homes for the homeless.

Wayanad: Site proposed for the establishment of the world's first tribal university.

note.subject: geography
note.why_in_news: IMD Director-General Mrutyunjay Mohapatra projected a normal Northeast monsoon despite a 20% Southwest monsoon deficit, impacting rainfall distribution across India.
note.fact_box: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) reported a 20% deficit in the Southwest monsoon. Rainfall for the Northeast monsoon is expected to be normal to above normal in coastal Tamil Nadu starting the third week of October.

prelims_pointers.text: Southwest monsoon deficit recorded at 20% for the current season.
Coastal Tamil Nadu and South India are primary recipients of Northeast monsoon rainfall.
Northeast monsoon typically begins in October and provides significant rainfall to the Coromandel Coast.

note.mains_question: Analyze the impact of monsoon variability on India's agricultural cycle and the importance of IMD's early warning systems in mitigating climate-induced risks.
